description: Every /set handler ends with the same 6-line pattern: 'if map.is_empty() { Value::Null } else { Value::Object(map) }' for each of created/updated/destroyed/notCreated/notUpdated/notDestroyed. This pattern is repeated in chat.rs, space.rs, mailbox.rs, identity.rs, submission.rs, vacation.rs. A contributor adding a new /set handler must reproduce this pattern correctly; a mistake (e.g. sending Value::Object({}) instead of Value::Null for an empty map) violates RFC 8620 §5.3 nullability. A helper fn null_if_empty_map(m: serde_json::Map<_,_>) -> Value or a macro would make this non-copyable.
title: /set response body construction: 6-arm null-vs-map pattern repeated in every handler
